name: 16137 · Mercer, PA
findings: ZIP 16137 (Mercer) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16137 (Mercer) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16137 (Mercer) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
